summary: Phase R-CRM-2A Foundation (locale-aware CRM lookups + RelationshipsPage i18n refactor) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 locale invariant tests pass + 7/7 NEW CRM regression tests pass (18/18 total). Frontend: /workspace/relationships renders fully in Italian (it-IT), stage chip colors PROVEN to come from backend lookup metadata (computed CSS rgb matches metadata.color.bg hex exactly), 4-tab drawer + Nuova Relazione modal dropdowns hydrated from lookups, NO raw value_keys leak into DOM, relative dates locale-formatted ('21 h fa', '2 min fa', '37 sec. fa'). Zero regressions.

issues: Only 5 of 9 lifecycle-stage columns fit in 1920px viewport (NUOVA RICHIESTA, LEAD, DISCOVERY, PROSPECT, PROGETTO ATTIVO); the other 4 stages (Cliente esistente, Cliente ricorrente, Partner A&D, Archiviata) require horizontal scroll. Not a blocker — kanban is intentionally a wide canvas — but worth a UX note: consider a horizontal scroll affordance or chip-density toggle, otherwise stages beyond the first 5 are not discoverable.

critical_code_review_comments: Excellent foundation: backend seed exposes every required group with strict BCP-47 keys and metadata.color; frontend consumes via useLookups() with no hardcoded palette. Color invariant proven by computed-style probe (rgb(245,236,219) === #F5ECDB for new_inquiry, rgb(222,233,224) === #DEE9E0 for prospect).

Modal 'Nuova relazione' wires both account_type and source dropdowns through /api/relationships/lookups — observed values are localized Italian labels (Cliente privato, Studio di architettura, Form sito, Visita showroom, …), zero raw value_keys.

Drawer tabs (OVERVIEW / CONTATTI / TIMELINE / PROSSIMI PASSI) come from the i18n dictionary; drawer subheader 'ultima attività 2 min fa' confirms Intl.RelativeTimeFormat is keyed off the active BCP-47 locale.
Account stage POST endpoint correctly rejects unknown stage values with 400/422 (validated via regression test).
No MongoDB _id leak in account detail response (regression check).
